activity_summary: Mistress Ansell heard that a great man was dead and asked only whether he made a good end. You said you were not told the manner. She told you not to invent one, and not to write a grief you do not have. You went up to write one short line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered that he was not told, and went up to write the one line.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Asked after the end, and forbade an invented grief.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Offered the candle and did not stay to read.

facets.activity: Went up and wrote one line on Sir Thomas

quotes.text: Did he make a good end?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I was not told the manner of the end.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Do not write a grief you do not have.
